title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the polarisation and increased repression in Serbia, one year after the Novi Sad tragedy
part_text: 16. Recalls that supporters of the Serbia Against Violence opposition, among them the Green-Left Front’s co-leader, engaged in violent demonstrations against the result of the parliamentary elections of December 2023; warns the EU that by supporting efforts to overturn a legitimate election result because of dissatisfaction with its outcome, it is undermining democracy and fuelling polarisation and instability;
